description: ILLUSTRATIVE public example of kye.category_map.v1 (§0.33). The canonical instance with precise internal artefact paths is IP-track and kept off the public surface; this public copy points each lifecycle stage at its public constitution chapter.

category.name: Authority Finality
category.one_liner: The runtime protocol that proves every consequential action was authorised, purpose-bound, evidenced, replayable and final before it changed the world.
category.frame: KYE = Know Your Entity + Authority Finality™. KYE does not run agents; KYE governs whether an agent's action may become final.

lifecycle_spine.label: Agent as Principal
lifecycle_spine.question: Is the actor a first-class governed principal?

lifecycle_spine.label: Delegated Authority Chain
lifecycle_spine.question: Who authorised whom, for what scope?

lifecycle_spine.label: Purpose & Scope
lifecycle_spine.question: Does the action match an approved purpose?

lifecycle_spine.label: Allowed Data / Tool / Model
lifecycle_spine.question: Is the data/tool/model allowed for this actor?

lifecycle_spine.label: Evidence Pack™
lifecycle_spine.question: Is there a signed action-level proof bundle?

lifecycle_spine.label: Replay Proof™
lifecycle_spine.question: Can it be reconstructed without trusting the vendor?

lifecycle_spine.label: Drift / Expiry / Revocation
lifecycle_spine.question: Has the authority drifted, expired or been revoked?

adjacencies.name: OSYRA
adjacencies.positioning_line: OSYRA controls the boundary where AI output becomes action — one gate in KYE's chain. KYE proves the full authority chain behind the action, end to end to finality.

adjacencies.name: RiCo (Runtime Integrity Control)
adjacencies.what_they_own: the transition between possibility and consequence (context/authority/execution/admissibility/continuity integrity at the point of execution)
adjacencies.positioning_line: RiCo governs the single transition to consequence; that is KYE's Finality Gate. KYE governs the whole lifecycle that earns the right to reach it — entity, delegation, purpose, evidence, replay — not just the last checkpoint.

adjacencies.name: SEILX
adjacencies.what_they_own: tamper-evident AI decision-time evidence integrity (the black box)
adjacencies.positioning_line: SEILX proves what happened at decision time — an input to KYE's evidence layer. KYE proves whether the action had authority and may become final.

adjacencies.name: Benchmarks.bio
adjacencies.what_they_own: capability assurance for biology agents (can the agent do the work?)
adjacencies.positioning_line: Benchmarks.bio proves capability; KYE proves authority. Capability evidence is a precondition that scopes authority via the Benchmark-to-Authority Gate — never permission to act.

adjacencies.name: Donald Andrechek / TTP
adjacencies.what_they_own: the thesis that AI governance must include evidence integrity
adjacencies.positioning_line: Evidence can be polished; authority cannot be faked. KYE's Replay Proof™ is reconstructable from public keys alone — the evidence-integrity bar TTP calls for, made non-repudiable.

follower_dilution_note: These are the diluted shared-middle terms OSYRA/RiCo/generic-GRC occupy. KYE primary positioning (hero/lede) MUST lead with the owned category (Authority Finality™) + the doctrine ladder, never with a lone denylisted phrase. Advisory scan over public hero/positioning surfaces (§0.33 invariant 3).
